utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Call the case, please, Madam Registrar.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Case number IT-00-41-I, the Prosecutor versus Pasko Ljubicic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: May we have appearances, please. For the Prosecution?

utterances.speaker: MR. CAYLEY
utterances.text: May it please the Court, Mr. President, my name is Cayley, and I appear on behalf of the Prosecutor with my colleague Ms. Magda Karagiannakis, and the case manager this afternoon is Kamala Janakiram. I'm actually standing in as senior trial attorney on this case for Mr. Harmon, who is absent from the office. He will in fact be the permanently assigned senior trial attorney assigned for this case.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. For the accused?

utterances.speaker: MR. JONJIC
utterances.text: My name is Jonjic, Mr. President. I am the attorney for Mr. Ljubicic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Ljubicic, will you please stand up? I will ask you some questions. Can you hear the proceedings in a language that you understand?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, I can.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Could also the microphone be placed closer to the accused or turned on? Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: May I have your full name, please.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] My name is Pasko Ljubicic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: What is the date upon which you believe you were born?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] 15 November, 1965.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: What is the address at which you resided before you were arrested?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Grga Novak street, number 28, in Zadar, Croatia.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. You may sit down, please. We are here this afternoon for the Initial Appearance of the accused in accordance with Rule 62 of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence, upon his transfer to the Tribunal. I should inform you that this case has been assigned by the order of the President to Trial Chamber I. Sitting on my right is His Excellency Judge Mohamed Elmadhi from Egypt. Sitting on my left is His Excellency Judge Alphons Orie from the Netherlands. My name is Judge Daqun Liu from China, the Presiding Judge in Trial Chamber I. Mr. Jonjic, has your client received a copy of the indictment in a language which he understands?

utterances.speaker: MR. JONJIC
utterances.text: Yes, he did, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Have you had a chance to go through it?

utterances.speaker: MR. JONJIC
utterances.text: Yes, we did.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Does your client fully understand the nature of this proceeding?

utterances.speaker: MR. JONJIC
utterances.text: Yes, the accused is fully aware of the indictment.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: If you have discussed the contents of the indictment fully with your client, may I know whether he wishes the indictment to be read out in full, which is his right, or he wishes to waive his right?

utterances.speaker: MR. JONJIC
utterances.text: It's not necessary to read the whole indictment.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: I'm very grateful to hear that. Does your client know that he must plead to the charges in the indictment within 30 days of the Initial Appearance? And if he so wishes, he can also do that today. Is he ready to enter a plea today?

utterances.speaker: MR. JONJIC
utterances.text: Yes, he is ready to enter a plea today.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Ljubicic, would you please stand up. I propose to read out to you just the charges, and then I will ask you, "How do you plead to those charges; guilty or not guilty?" Your answer in each case should be "guilty" or "not guilty," as the case may be. Is that clear?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, it is.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: The first count against you is a charge of persecutions on political, racial, or religious ground, being a crime against humanity. How do you plead; guilty or not guilty?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Very well. The second count is a charge of unlawful attack on civilians as a violation of the laws or customs of war. How do Blank page inserted to ensure pagination corresponds between the French and English transcripts. you plead; guilty or not guilty?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: The third count is a charge of murder, being in violation of the laws or customs of war. How do you plead; guilty or not guilty?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: The fourth count is another charge of murder, being a crime against humanity. Do you plead guilty or not guilty?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: The fifth count is a charge of violence to life and person as a violation of the laws and customs of war. How do you plead; guilty or not guilty?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: The sixth count is a charge of unhumane acts, being a crime against humanity. How do you plead; guilty or not guilty?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: The seventh count is a charge of devastation not justified by military necessity charged as a violation of the laws or customs of war. How do you plead; guilty or not guilty?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: The eighth count is a charge of destruction or willful damage to institutions dedicated to religion or education, being a violation of laws or customs of war. How do you plead; guilty or not guilty?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: The ninth count is a charge of plunder of public or private property, being a violation of the laws and customs of war. How do you plead; guilty or not guilty?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: The tenth count is a charge of cruel treatment as a violation of laws or customs of war. How do you plead; guilty or not guilty?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: The eleventh count is a charge of inhumane acts as a crime against humanity. How do you plead; guilty or not guilty?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Very well. You may sit down, please, sir. The Registrar will be instructed to fix a date for trial when appropriate, and the accused is remanded in custody until further order. The Trial Chamber has designated Judge Elmadhi as the Pre-Trial Judge. A Status Conference will be scheduled to take place within 120 days of this Initial Appearance in accordance with Rule 65 bis, and all of you will be informed of that date. At this moment, I would like to remind the prosecutors of your obligations under Rule 66(A)(i) of the rules of the procedure and evidence with regard to the disclosure of the supporting materials within 30 days of today. I also would like to remind counsel of the accused whether you will continue to serve as his counsel after today or not. The preliminary motions pursuant to Rule 72 may be filed on behalf of the accused no later than 20 days after disclosure by the prosecutors pursuant to Rule 62(A)(i). Is there any matter which the Prosecution which to raise at this stage? Mr. Cayley.

utterances.speaker: MR. CAYLEY
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. President, just one matter. You referred the Prosecutor to her obligation under Rule 66(A)(i) in respect of disclosure of the supporting material. I can inform the Court that I met with Mr. Jonjic at 2.00 before the proceedings, and I can also inform the Court that we substantially complied at that time with our obligation under Rule 66(A)(i) in that we have made disclosure of all of the supporting material to the indictment except for one matter, and that is this: Part of the supporting material consists of court transcripts from the Blaskic case. Whilst we have disclosed those transcripts in English, which Mr. Jonjic understands, we are yet to provide to the Defence, in a language -- these transcripts in a language that the accused can understand - in the Croatian language - and we are in the process of organising either audio or videotapes of the proceedings relevant to those transcripts, which will contain the audio recording in the Croatian language of the proceedings, and we will do that within the 30-day time limit that the Rules prescribe.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you very much for your information. Mr. Jonjic, do you want to raise any matters at this stage?

utterances.speaker: MR. JONJIC
utterances.text: No, it's not necessary, Mr. President.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Well, are you going to be with your client for the whole trial or just for this Initial Appearance?

utterances.speaker: MR. JONJIC
utterances.text: For the whole trial.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you very much. I believe you'll have much more chance to talk to your client about his rights. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: I believe that is all. We will now adjourn the proceedings.

procedural_notes.text: --- Whereupon the Initial Appearance adjourned at
